blocks.tamil_translation: raise you with your name recorded in the list of those who loved self-praise and fought to get much war booty (Ghanimah) (it will be announced on the plain of Mahshar that this man fought for show and to gain much wealth). O Abdullah, in whatever state (with whatever intention) you fight or are killed, in that same state (with that same intention) Allah Ta'ala will raise you on the Day of Qiyamah,” Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: قَالَ اللهُ تَعَالي: (وَاِذَا قَامُوْا اِلَي الصَّلوةِ قَامُوْا كُسَالي لا يُرَآءُوْنَ النَّاسَ وَلَا يَذْكُرُوْنَ اللهَ اِلَّا قَلِيْلاً۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: When they stand for Salah, they stand lazily, only showing off to people (that they too are among those who pray). And they do not remember Allah (in Salah) except very little.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّيْنَ ۞ الَّذِيْنَ هُمْ عَنْ صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُوْنَ ۞ الَّذِيْنَ هُمْ يُرَآءُوْنَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: So, woe to those who pray (heedlessly) - they are those who are heedless of their Salah, and they are those who (pray to) show off to others.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Being heedless of Salah means praying after its time has passed, praying with thoughts of the world, praying on and off (leaving it at times), and the like.
(Kashf-ur-Rahman)
